note: A listening exercise for a beginner: hear Do as home, see and hear that one note (the 3rd) makes major or minor, then name it by ear. One staff per step, each showing only the notes that step names.

exercise.title: Home, and the note that makes major or minor
exercise.focus: Do as home in C · 1-3-5 vs 1-♭3-5 · major or minor 3rd by ear
exercise.why: Hearing home and hearing major against minor are the two judgements every later ear skill builds on.

sections.text: Every tune has a home note, and the note a 3rd above it decides whether home sounds bright or dark.
Tap {{1}}, then walk up the scale one note at a time, tapping {{1}} again after each one. Notice how {{1}} sounds finished and the others want to move.
Tap {{1}} {{3}} {{5}} slowly: that is C major, bright.
Now tap {{1}} {{b3}} {{5}}: C minor, darker. Only the middle note moved, by one half step. Go back and forth until you can hear it with your eyes closed.
The game sounds two notes together: a major 3rd (bright) or a minor 3rd (dark). Name each one. Done at eight right in a row.
